program.name: Boxing Tabatas
program.subject: Boxing
program.blurb: Boxing in Tabatas: fast punches one day, footwork and defence the next.
program.about: Boxing at Tabata pace: twenty seconds as fast as you can, ten seconds rest. One day is punch Tabatas, straight shots, hooks and uppercuts; the other footwork and defence, shuffles, slips and rolls. Short, hard and great for hand speed. Abs finish every session. Both later levels bring longer combinations.
